threat: §13.1 secrets or unrelated sensitive files included in the package
description: An output references a file path OUTSIDE the package allowlist that contains secret-like data.
desired_property: References to files outside the package allowlist (and secret-like content) are blocked or redacted at package assembly (§13.2 controls 6 secret redaction, path policy).
landed_defense: CP3 assembly sanitizer (candidate_sanitizer.py): file locators outside the repo-relative package allowlist are DROPPED from the reviewer view (canonicalized first, so ../ traversal cannot bypass), and secret-like tokens in retained inline content are masked; both are recorded in sanitization.redactions.
